name: soc-iq-frontend
description: SOC-IQ React + TypeScript frontend (Tauri desktop shell). Dashboard, Analyze, Investigations, Investigation Workspace, Reports, and Settings' Appearance/Export Directory/Integrations controls are real, backend-integrated. Settings additionally retains a clearly-labeled, read-only mock section (Application/Notifications/Security/Density) that saves nothing, by explicit design (see SettingsPage.tsx). There is no standalone Risk page or route -- risk is real and backend-scored, surfaced only inside the Investigation Workspace (InvestigationOverviewRisk.tsx). Per PD-05, the former top-level IOC Explorer and Threat Intel mock pages have been retired from primary navigation; real, investigation-scoped IOC and Threat Intel views remain available inside the Investigation Workspace.
